description: The plot illustrates the relationship between activated parameters ratio and evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) for different transformer configurations. The x-axis is labeled “Activated Parameters Ratio (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 100 to 25, with tick labels at intervals of 25. The y-axis is labeled “Eval PPL.” and has a linear scale ranging from 11.0 to 14.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. A dashed orange line, labeled “Transformer”, begins at approximately (100, 11.5) and remains relatively constant at approximately (25, 11.5). A solid gray line with circular markers, labeled “Only MoHD FFN”, begins at approximately (100, 12.2) and increases to approximately (25, 13.2). A solid dark gray line with circular markers, labeled “Only MoHD ATTN”, begins at approximately (100, 12.2) and decreases to approximately (25, 13.1). A dashed blue line with cross markers, labeled “MoHD ATTN + MLP”, begins at approximately (100, 13.3) and decreases to approximately (25, 12.8).
